lines.opener: *a stone beast leans out over the passage, water dribbling from its jaws* Grrlbl... HALT! Glorrg... you... EVIL? Blrrb... speak!
lines.openerHostile: *a jet of filthy rainwater hits you in the chest* EVIL! Grrrlbl... AWAY! AWAY from WALL!
lines.like: *it gargles happily; water sloshes out of its mouth* Blrrb... YES! Glorg... good!
lines.dislike: *it spits, offended* Grrk! NOT... glbbl... NOT that!
lines.hate: *its throat roars like a flooded drain* FIRE?! Glrrrrk... NEVER AGAIN! *it lunges, spitting*
lines.flirt: *it stares at the wink, then spits a neat stream of water at your boots*
lines.join: *it climbs down off the wall, heavy as a millstone, and crouches at your heel* Blrrb... GUARD... you. Glorg.
lines.demand: *holds out a stone claw* Grrlbl... TOLL. Coins. Blrrb... for the WALL.
lines.gift: *coughs something up into your hand, along with a lot of water* Glorg... TAKE. Fang. Evil... AWAY.
lines.letPass: *it settles back onto its ledge and stares off over your head* Glrrb... PASS. Not evil.
lines.ai: *it cocks its stone head* Glrrb... A... WHAT? *spits, suspicious* EVIL word!
lines.refuseJoin: *shakes its heavy head, spraying water* Grrlbl... NO. Wall. MINE.
lines.leaveNow: *it turns its back and goes still, a carving once more* ...blrb.
